issues.issue: The AI badge is white text on #13BFEB at 2.05:1, and that same badge appears on all three tool cards and all seven More tools tiles.
The More tools captions are #777871 on #0D1010, 4.29:1 at roughly 11px, so the row's seven labels sit under the AA threshold for their size while the icons above them read fine.
The left rail stops at AI design around y=405 and the next 350px of column is empty until the promo card pinned at the bottom, and AI design is the only item with no section label above it.
Disabled AI tool rows are #C6C4C6 on white, 1.71:1, so Eye Contact, Green screen and Automatic multicam cannot be read, and the Beta tags use the same faded treatment as unavailable rows.
In the AI Tools list, Remove filler words uses a hash mark and Shorten word gaps uses a bracket-and-dots mark as their icons while the other eight rows use drawn 1.5px line icons.
The right side runs two parallel navigations at once, a horizontal AI Tools tab with a search field plus a vertical icon rail repeating AI Tools, Project, Properties, Elements, Captions and Stock.
Add more credits is a light filled pill in the header and is the highest-contrast control on the screen, louder than Select, Filter and the search field beside it.
The B-roll label above the right rail's first item is #383838 on #090A0B, 1.7:1, so it is effectively invisible next to the white labels below it.
The repeated Fill labels on the timeline band are about 10px, smaller than the 11px rail labels, and sit under a preview where every other label is 13px or larger.
Tags sit immediately after each title instead of in a fixed column, so pills begin just past the truncated title in ENG-139 and at the far right in ENG-742, and no tag edge lines up row to row.
The leftmost priority column carries a three-bar chart glyph on ENG-139, ENG-416 and ENG-742 but a three-dash mark on the other five rows, two unrelated marks in one column.
The view tabs use three treatments at one level: All issues is plain text, Active is a filled chip, and Backlog and Recent Urgent Bugs are outlined chips.

Hairlines sit under Font at y=361, the caption field at y=558, In/Out/Length at y=643 and the download row at y=780, but nothing separates Style from Extras, so sections at the same depth are bounded inconsistently.
The Custom colour swatch is a bare white circle with a thin grey ring, the same ring treatment the selected swatch gets in black, so two different meanings share one mark and Custom reads as unset.
Two labels read Clips within 70px, the breadcrumb at 13px and the list header Clips 6 at 15px, naming the view and the list with the same word.

The Transcript row's actions overflow the card padding: Copy, Download and a ? button run to the edge and the overflow menu is clipped to a single dot at the card's right edge, while every other row ends cleanly with Download and a kebab.
Two equally sized primaries sit side by side in the header, the purple Create and the dark Ask Co-Creator, while the row actions below are all identical ghost Downloads with no weight distinction.

The active Sound Effects tab is set about 2px larger than the inactive Music tab and carries both a 2px white ring and a 3px underline, so the tab group changes size on switch and the selected state has two competing marks.

notes: Only P5 has an error screen and no product shows an empty state, so the other five are scored on the states they do show. P2's cliplist was captured with a row menu open that dims the app to about 74% brightness (card #BDBCBC beside a #FFFFFF popover), which limits contrast reading there.
